31: Protection provided against weapon scrambling damage. Increases by the given factor how much scramble damage a ship can withstand before its weapons are as scrambled as those of an unprotected ship.
33: Energy consumed per second when resisting ion damage.
34: Fuel consumed per second when resisting ion damage.
35: Heat generated per second when resisting ion damage.
36: Speed at which this ship appears to land or travel through a wormhole.
38: Energy consumed per second when resisting scrambling damage.
39: Fuel consumed per second when resisting scrambling damage.
40: Heat generated per second when resisting scrambling damage.
41: The maximum velocity the ship can jump at.
42: Fuel consumed when jumping between systems using this hyperdrive.
43: Fuel consumed when jumping between systems using this jump drive.
44: The maximum distance this drive can jump.
45: Fuel consumed per 100 tons of mass when jumping. Additive with jump fuel.
46: Modifies the impact your ship's mass has on the jump mass cost. Ships below this mass will have a cheaper jump cost than the base jump fuel cost, while ships above this mass will have more expensive jumps.
47: Protection provided against leak damage. Increases by the given factor how much leak damage a ship can withstand before it loses as much fuel as an unprotected ship.
49: Energy consumed per second when resisting leak damage.
50: Fuel consumed per second when resisting leak damage.
51: Heat generated per second when resisting leak damage.
52: Credits spent per day to maintain this outfit. Even if a ship is parked or an outfit is in cargo, you still need to pay for its maintenance.
53: The number of star systems included in this map.
54: Mass of this ship when not carrying any cargo or fighters. Cargo increases mass, which reduces acceleration and turn rate and increases maximum heat before overheating.
55: Mass, in tons. A ship's mass determines how fast it turns and accelerates and its maximum heat before overheating.
56: The maximum speed of this ship when using thrusters. Excludes the effect of afterburners, unless there are no normal thrusters installed.
57: Movement while both your primary thrusters and afterburners are active.
58: How quickly this ship can accelerate and turn.
59: How quickly this ship can accelerate and turn when its cargo hold is full versus when it is empty.
60: Credits spent per day to maintain this outfit when it is in active use.
